# Jane Andrews

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018)</sub>

## Appearance

Jane is an Avonlea girl who attends school.

_Sources: [v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040)_

## Personality

Jane is considered a sensible and plain girl who is neat in her habits. She is practical, matter-of-fact, and lacks a strong imagination, preferring realistic and sensible things over romantic ones. Though she intends to be firm, she can be easily moved to tears during emotional moments, such as school farewells.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064), [v1 c13 P13](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0013), [v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 c17 P19](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0019), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## History

Jane Andrews grew up in Avonlea as part of the Andrews family. She attended the local Avonlea school, where she sat in the fifth book class and competed academically alongside her classmates. She formed a close friendship with Anne Shirley, Diana Barry, and Ruby Gillis, joining them in games, singing, and constructing playhouses. In school, she excelled in subjects like dictation and arithmetic, though she struggled somewhat with Latin. She later joined the Queen's Academy preparation class under Miss Stacy's instruction to study for her teaching license. Jane was also an active member of the Story Club, where she wrote extremely sensible stories devoid of romance, and participated in the school's Christmas concert performance.

_Sources: [v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c13 P2](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0002), [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P76](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0076), [v1 c17 P21](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0021), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014)_
